title: Possible Cyclic dependencies error with classes referencing eachother, with no clear error message
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700G with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

Please check the code bellow (or the uploaded project).

```gdscript
extends Resource
class_name ItemManager

enum ITEM{ANTIDOTE, POTION, SWORD}

const ITEM_LIST : Dictionary[ITEM,Item]= {
	ITEM.ANTIDOTE : preload("res://items/antidote.tres"),
	ITEM.POTION : preload("res://items/potion.tres"),
	ITEM.SWORD : preload("res://items/sword.tres"),
	}
	
static func get_item( item : ITEM ) -> Item:
	return ITEM_LIST[item]
```

```gdscript
extends Resource
class_name Item

@export var my_enum		:= ItemManager.ITEM.POTION
@export var item_name 	:= ""
@export var item_price 	:= 0
```

```gdscript
extends Node2D

# var error = preload("res://items/potion.tres") ## Uncommenting this causes the error.

func _ready() -> void:
	var i : Item =  ItemManager.get_item(ItemManager.ITEM.ANTIDOTE)
	print( i.item_name )
```

The code above causes the error message "**Parser Error: Could not preload resource file "res://items/antidote.tres**"." on the class ItemManager if you remove the "#" on the "var error = preload("res://items/potion.tres")" line.

I *think* this is a cyclic redundancy error, but the error message isn't very clear so I'm not sure. 
Since the error message is a bit misleading, it was a bit hard to actually diagnose what was causing the error message on my actual project.

This bug report is more related to the lack of a clear error message than the cyclic dependency error itself.

### Steps to reproduce

Run the MRP or copy/paste the code.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[debug_project_2025-03-06_20-59-05.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19116827/debug_project_2025-03-06_20-59-05.zip)
